title: stellar.org site search and page text (keyless)
description: Two authored operations over the Stellar Development Foundation's website, stellar.org: the site's own keyless search endpoint and a host-side read of one server-rendered page. Blog, press and events rows are filtered out because other sources hold that content. The catalog builder maps each operation 1:1 to a CatalogEntry; the adapter (src/adapters/stellar-org.ts) owns the origin, the path guard, the redirect rule and the size cap.
authoredBy: Golden coverage audit, lane sorg (.agents/rounds/2026-11-14-golden-coverage-audit/decisions/SORG.md); measurements in research/services/stellar-org-site.md

constraints.searchShape: GET /api/search?q=<query>&locale=en returns { query, locale, results: [{ id, kind, title, description, tags, url, isExternal }] } with at most 10 rows; kind is page or partner. A missing q, or one over 200 characters, returns 400 { error: "invalid_query" }.
constraints.filtered: Rows whose path is under /blog, /press or /events, rows with isExternal true, and partner rows are dropped. Partner rows link to a query string on /ecosystem, whose page renders no partner detail; Scout and Lumenloop own partners.
constraints.pages: Pages are server-rendered HTML of 410-500 KB (2026-11-14). The adapter keeps the <main> text, follows same-origin redirects only, refuses a body over 2,000,000 bytes, bounds one read to 24 s, cuts content at 40,000 characters, and returns soft-empty when the page renders no server-side text.

operations.name: search_site
operations.description: Search the SDF website, stellar.org, for pages the Stellar Development Foundation publishes about itself: the SDF strategy and annual objectives, the product roadmap, the Soroban Security Audit Bank and its security-audited projects list, and the service providers directory listing agencies and audit partners. Returns site-search rows with title, description, page path, kind and tags; read one page with stellarOrg.get_page.

query.description: Keywords or a short question for the stellar.org site search, such as "strategy", "roadmap" or "service providers". The site refuses more than 200 characters.

operations.returns: { hits: [{ title, description, path, kind, tags }], meta: { candidates } }.

hits.description: The hits live under `data.hits`. Empty when every site-search row was a blog, press, events or external row.

path.description: Site-relative path on https://stellar.org; pass it to stellarOrg.get_page.

candidates.description: Rows the site search returned before filtering.

operations.name: get_page
operations.description: Read the main text from one stellar.org page, given its path: /foundation/strategy, /foundation/roadmap, /audit-bank/projects, /ecosystem/service-providers and other paths from stellarOrg.search_site rows. Returns the page title, URL and text with headings and list items kept.

path.description: Site-relative page path starting with /, such as "/foundation/strategy". Full URLs, query strings, percent-encoded characters and /api paths are refused.
The path served, after any same-origin redirect.

content.description: Main page text. Client-side lists, such as later pages of the audited-projects list, are not in the server-rendered text.

truncated.description: Present and true when content was cut at 40,000 characters.
